newsitem.title: CHILE: Rio Algom, Orvana win Codelco exploration deals.
newsitem.headline: Rio Algom, Orvana win Codelco exploration deals.

text.p: Chile state copper company Codelco said it has awarded exploration contracts on two gold deposits to Canadian firms Rio Algom Ltd and Orvana Minerals Corp.
Rio Algom will prospect on the Inca de Oro deposit, which lies 200 kilometers west of the corporation's Salvador division, said exploration and development vice-president Ivan Valenzuela.
The company is commited to spending $5 million over three years at Inca de Oro, or $10 million in five years, he said.

Orvana Minerals won the contract to explore the Quebrada Valiente copper and gold deposit, also near the Salvador mine. Under the deal, the firm will invest up to $3 million in five years on the property.
Codelco owns vast areas of land in northern Chile and is keen to sign deals with private companies to carry out basic exploration on its properties.
